meta.description: Organic extra virgin olive oil from the foothills of Mount Taygetus. Goranoi and Kokkina Louria, Lakonia.

home.hero: Organic extra virgin olive oil from the foothills of Mount Taygetus
home.definition: The lower slopes at the base of a mountain, where the mountain meets the land below.
home.taygetus: Our centuries-old olive trees lie at the foothills of Mount Taygetus. The mountainous altitude and distinctive microclimate give our olive oil a unique aromatic and flavor profile.

about.title: Who we are
about.intro: We are two olive farmers from Lakonia. We farm our centuries-old olive groves organically, at the foothills of Mount Taygetus.
about.groves: The groves are in Goranoi and Kokkina Louria, at the foot of Taygetus.
about.why: Propodes is the lowest part of a mountain, where the slope meets the land. The oil takes its name from there.
about.houseAlt: A stone house in the olive grove
about.trunkAlt: The trunk of a centuries-old olive tree

oilPage.title: The olive oil
oilPage.intro: Superior category olive oil obtained directly from olives and solely by mechanical means.
oilPage.harvestAlt: Freshly picked olives on harvest nets
oilPage.fruitCaption: Green and dark olives from the same picking.
oilPage.netsAlt: Harvest nets spread through the grove
oilPage.legal: Organic extra virgin olive oil. Ingredients: organic extra virgin olive oil.
oilPage.storage: Keep in a dry, cool and dark place.
oilPage.packed: Produced and packed in Greece on behalf of the producers G. Kalkanis and F. Chrisadakos, Goranoi – Kokkina Louria, Laconia, 230 54.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p1: The contact form asks for a name, a phone or email, and optionally a product, quantity, delivery area and message. We send these to the producers so they can reply to an order or a question.
privacy.p2: We do not sell these details or use them for advertising. The site does not set analytics cookies.
privacy.p3: To correct or delete what you sent, write to info@propodes.com or call the numbers on the label.
